CFML Language Reference: Tags

CFCOOKIE

CFCOOKIE adds a Set-Cookie header to the response, so the browser sends the value back as Cookie.name on later requests. Cookies can last for the browser session, a number of days, until a given date or "forever".

Category

Variable manipulation

Syntax

<CFCOOKIE NAME="cookie_name"
    VALUE="text"
    EXPIRES="period"
    SECURE="Yes/No"
    PATH="url_path"
    DOMAIN=".domain">

Attributes

NAME
Required. Name of the cookie. Browsers receive it in upper case.
VALUE
Optional. Value to store. It is URL-encoded in the header and decoded again when it comes back.
EXPIRES
Optional. When the cookie expires: a date (12/31/1999), a number of days (30), NEVER (30 years from now) or NOW (deletes the cookie). Without EXPIRES the cookie lasts until the browser is closed.
SECURE
Optional, default "No". Yes asks the browser to send the cookie over SSL connections only.
PATH
Optional, default "/". URL path the cookie applies to.
DOMAIN
Optional. Domain the cookie applies to, starting with a period, for example .gibson.example.

Usage

The cookie also appears in the Cookie scope of the current request right away, so the page can use Cookie.name straight after setting it. A cookie deleted with EXPIRES="NOW" disappears from the scope.

Browsers of the day are happy to store about 20 cookies per site at 4K each; keep the values short. For anything bigger, store an ID in the cookie and the data on the server (see CFAPPLICATION client and session management).

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<!--- A visit counter kept in a cookie --->
<CFPARAM NAME="URL.Forget" DEFAULT="No">
<CFPARAM NAME="Cookie.SnipVisits" DEFAULT="0">

<CFIF URL.Forget>
  <CFCOOKIE NAME="SnipVisits" EXPIRES="NOW">
  <P>The cookie has been deleted. The browser will not send it again.</P>
<CFELSE>
  <CFCOOKIE NAME="SnipVisits" VALUE="#Cookie.SnipVisits + 1#" EXPIRES="30">
  <CFOUTPUT>
  <TABLE BORDER=1 CELLPADDING=4>
  <TR><TD BGCOLOR="##FFFFCC">Visits counted by the cookie</TD><TD><B>#Cookie.SnipVisits#</B></TD></TR>
  <TR><TD BGCOLOR="##FFFFCC">Cookie expires</TD><TD>#DateFormat(Now() + 30, "mmmm d, yyyy")#</TD></TR>
  </TABLE>
  </CFOUTPUT>
</CFIF>
<P><A HREF="cfcookie.cfm">Visit again</A> | <A HREF="cfcookie.cfm?Forget=Yes">Delete the cookie</A></P>
